chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from Is'haq ibn Ibrahim Al-Ju'fi, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered the chamber of Umm Salma (peace be upon her) and smelled a good aroma, so he said: "Has Al-Hawla come to you?"' She said: 'It is she. She is complaining about her husband.' So Al-Hawla came out to him and said: 'May my father and mother be sacrificed for you! My husband has turned away from me.' He said: 'Increase it (the perfume), O Hawla.' She said: 'I have not left any good perfume that I do not use it for him, and he turns away from me.' He said: 'But if only he knew what is for him with his facing towards you.' She said: 'And what is for him with facing towards me?' He said: 'Indeed, when he faces you, two angels encircle him, so he is like the striker of his sword in the Way of Allah. And when he copulates, the sins fall off from him as the leaves of the tree fall. And when he bathes, he is stripped of the sins.'

key_terms.الْحَوْلَاءُ: Al-Hawla (a proper name, likely a servant or attendant of Umm Salma)
key_terms.وَورَقُ الشَّجَرِ: And the leaves of the tree

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for marital intimacy in Shia Islam according to the hadith of Umm Salma?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encourages Umm Salma to use perfume to rekindle her husband's affection, illustrating the Shia emphasis on *zawjiyyah* (marital companionship) as a form of worship rather than mere physical act. He draws a parallel between marital intimacy and *jihad*, noting that sexual union results in the shedding of sins like falling leaves, while subsequent ritual bathing (*ghusl*) provides further purification. This narrative underscores the spiritual merit of maintaining marital harmony and counters the notion of ascetic neglect of conjugal duties.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al Jowhary, from Is’haq Bin Ibrahim Al Ju’fy who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> entered the chamber of Umm Salma<sup>as</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> smelt a good aroma. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Al-Hawla came to you<sup>as</sup>?’ So she<sup>as</sup> said, ‘It is so. She is complaining about her husband’. So Al-Hawla came out to him<sup>saww</sup> and she said, ‘May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you<sup>saww</sup>! My husband has turned away from me’ So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Increase it (the perfuming), O Hawla’. She said, ‘I have not left any perfume from what I perfume myself for him with it, and he turns away from me’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘But, if only he knew what is for him with his facing towards you’. She said, ‘And what is for him with facing towards me?’ So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘But he, when he faces you, two Angels would encircle him, so he would be like the striker of his sword in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So when he copulates, the sins would fall off from him like the falling of the leaves of the tree. So when he bathes, his sins would be pulled away’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhariy from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Al-Ju‘fiy who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once went to the house of ‘Umm Salamah, smelled a fine fragrance and asked, ’Had al-Hawla’ come to you?’ She replied, ’She is here, complaining against her husband.’ Al-Hawla then came out and said, ’I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, my husband turns away from me.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘Use more perfume, O Hawla’. She said, ‘I have not left any perfume without being tried to make him happy but he turns away from me.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) then said, ’I wish he learns what he receives by coming forward to you.’ She asked, ’What can he receive by being forthcoming to me?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘If he comes to you he will be circled by two angels and he will be like one who has pulled his sword from its sheath in the way of Allah; and when he goes to bed with his wife, sins fall off of him like the falling of leaves from the tree and when he takes Ghusl (bath), he comes clean out of sins.”’
